ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the middle of the circuit diagram is a two-to-one multiplexer labeled “2×1 MUX”. The upper input terminal on the left is labeled I0, and this terminal is connected to the ground symbol, indicating logic 0; the lower input terminal on the left is labeled I1 and is connected to input P; the selection terminal at the bottom is labeled Sel and is connected to input Q; the output terminal on the right is labeled Y. Reasoning: For a 2×1 MUX, if the selection terminal is Q, then the output is Y = I0·Q' + I1·Q. From the connections in the figure, it can be known that I0 = 0 and I1 = P, therefore Y = 0·Q' + P·Q = P Q.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown, \(P\) and \(Q\) are the inputs. Express the logical output \(Y\) in terms of \(P\) and \(Q\).

method.method_draft: First identify from the image that the block is a 2×1 multiplexer, with I0 connected to logic 0, I1 connected to P, and the select line connected to Q. From the text, P and Q are the inputs and Y is the requested logical output. Use the MUX output equation with Q as select: Y = I0 Q' + I1 Q. Substitute the visually read connections I0=0 and I1=P, giving Y = 0·Q' + P·Q = PQ.

method.method_draft: Describe the image connections: I0 is grounded, I1 is P, and Sel is Q. Consider two cases. If Q=0, the MUX selects I0, so Y=0. If Q=1, the MUX selects I1, so Y=P. Thus Y is 1 only in the case Q=1 and P=1; otherwise it is 0. This truth-table behavior is exactly the AND function, so Y = P Q.
method.CoT_raw: Image description: The attached circuit diagram shows a 2 × 1 multiplexer. The upper data input I0 is connected to the ground symbol, so I0 is logic 0. The lower data input I1 is connected to input P. The select input labeled Sel is connected to input Q. The output on the right is labeled Y. Reasoning: A 2 × 1 MUX outputs I0 when Sel = 0 and outputs I1 when Sel = 1. Since Sel = Q, if Q = 0 then Y = I0 = 0. If Q = 1 then Y = I1 = P. Therefore Y is 1 only when both P = 1 and Q = 1, which is the AND function.
